newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH MAY OIL PRODUCTS SALES FALL 3 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH MAY OIL PRODUCTS SALES FALL 3 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Finnish oil products sales fell about three percent year-on-year in May to 684,000 tonnes, the Finnish Petroleum Association said in its monthly review received on Friday.
Diesel oil sales rose four percent in May while motor petroleum sales were flat, the association said.

In January-May, motor petroleum sales were up three percent year-on-year at 725,900 tonnes, diesel oil sales rose six percent to 643,700 tonnes while domestic heating oil sales fell eight percent to 950,000 tonnes and industrial heating oil sales fell 13 percent to 595,000 tonnes, it said.
Total sales in Finland of oil products in the first five months fell four percent on the year-ago period to 3.65 million tonnes, it said.
